0022600093.text: Both teams open their 2026-27 seasons when the LA Clippers host the Sacramento Kings, as neither has played a game yet this season. The Clippers are missing Bradley Beal (knee inflammation), Jordan Miller (shoulder surgery), Max Strus (foot) and Yanic Konan Niederhauser (foot surgery), while Sacramento is without Ben Simmons (ruptured Achilles), Dylan Cardwell (calf strain) and Maxime Raynaud (dislocated knee), and Malik Monk is day-to-day with ankle soreness and a game-time decision. The Clippers won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, including a 138-109 win over the Kings in Sacramento on April 5, 2026.
